## Summary
Rework UI status line and tab bar to match vim aesthetic
## Description
Update the header and footer to look more like a vim statusline. Show mode in color-coded blocks, add position indicator, improve the tab bar with item counts.
## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Statusline shows mode | screen | branch | position
- [ ] Tab bar shows active tab with item count badge
- [ ] Nvim mode indicator when running inside Neovim
- [ ] Consistent color scheme matching vim aesthetics
